title: Trees in the Support Compute the Function
statement: Let $T$ be a randomized decision tree computing a function $f$ on inputs of length $n$, and let $S$ be a deterministic decision tree in the support of the distribution of trees selected by $T$. Then $S$ computes $f$ on every input.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a randomized decision tree with finite nonempty seed space and computes $f$ for every seed
The deterministic tree $S$ belongs to the support of the tree distribution induced by $T$
